source: Own measurement through `ale validate` for version 0.2 (the rig: camera head angle, video latency, 5/10 mm instruments; generator endosim-procedure/0.3): run validate-7485b98b on the tree of 88705800, the pinned engine bfb7505 (0.1.1), the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh; solution/reference: privileged tips, scope, camera head angle and latency in place of perception and identification; rate commands through the public wire) as the oracle episode, graded in the engine's separate verifier sandbox (the renderer as its own account, the controller behind the network filter) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps with the rigs drawn by tests/review/draw_rigs.py): useful_view_fraction 0.8760417 (per procedure 0.8788 0.8500 0.9137 0.9163 0.7950 0.8562 0.7887 0.9325 0.8750 0.9275 0.9113 0.8675), probe pairs 187 of 580 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no aborted procedure, no lens contact, no renderer or solver restart; the canary found 10 of 10 markers within 1.24 px; 121 ms a frame; verify 1453 s. Host: the author's validate host, one NVIDIA RTX 3090 on driver 535.183.01 (below Omniverse RTX's R550 floor, hence the renderer's driver check off), an Intel i9-12900K, Docker 29.10.1 in rootless mode, which cannot set a CPU quota: the engine's --cpus 8 was dropped and every process started through docker exec was pinned to 8 CPUs by affinity (OCI execCPUAffinity) instead. The same mean to the last digit as the native run on 582152e4 (the same task code; RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570.195.03, outside the engine: 0.8760417, 172 of 604 pairs differing); single procedures differ by a step or so either way, as different probe draws make them. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer, but it depends a little on which steps are probed: over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop (tests/review/fast_eval.py's sessions) gave 0.8752 to 0.8759. full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Version 0.1's anchor was 0.903 (validate-3f6c0b60). Status: tests/README.md section 7.
